intro.title: Learn it: make 20 with two frames!
intro.say: Let’s make twenty with two ten-frames. A full ten, and some more. Tap Start.

bond: The castle needs {t} flags. {a} flags are up. How many more?
{name} has {a} shields. How many more make {t}?
There are {t} seats at the feast. {a} knights sit down. How many seats are empty?
{name} needs {t} stones for the wall. {name} has {a}. How many more?
add: {a} knights ride in. {b} more join them. How many knights?
{name} picks {a} roses in the royal garden, then {b} more. How many roses?
The cook bakes {a} pies, then {b} more. How many pies?
{name} has {a} ribbons. The queen gives {name} {b} more. How many ribbons?
take: {a} guards stand on the wall. {b} go home. How many guards are left?
{name} has {a} gold coins. {name} spends {b} at the fair. How many coins are left?
There are {a} lanterns. {b} go out. How many are still lit?
{name} has {a} apples for the horses. The horses eat {b}. How many apples are left?
